claim.supported_scope: A planned bootstrap-based comparison of exactly two observed groups using independently indexed plsc_bootstrap_v1 distributions, attenuation-corrected Group A minus Group B paths and loadings, and a required plsc_permutation_v1 measurement-invariance decision.
claim.estimand: The group-specific attenuation-corrected PLSc parameters and their difference, with a frozen two-sided empirical bootstrap-tail probability and group/difference confidence intervals under the bounded two-group design.
assumptions: Both groups satisfy the same reflective plsc_v2 model, preprocessing, missing-data, weighting, convergence, and canonical orientation contract.
Cases are exchangeable sampling units within each group and the two group samples are independent.
Structural group differences are interpreted only for constructs with at least partial invariance under the exact paired plsc_permutation_v1 result.
exclusions: More than two groups, parametric pooled-variance tests, Welch-Satterthwaite tests, one-tailed claims, interactions, higher-order constructs, weights, PCA weighting, and matrix-only input are excluded.
Ordinary PLS group bootstrap or permutation output cannot be relabeled as consistent MGA evidence.
Bootstrap-tail evidence does not establish causality, practical importance, semantic equivalence, or measurement invariance.
warnings: Parameters without paired partial-invariance support remain visible only as uninterpretable diagnostics.
Both group bootstraps must meet their frozen usable-replicate thresholds; one successful group cannot compensate for failure in the other.

equations.expression: d_j = PLSc_v2(D_A)_j - PLSc_v2(D_B)_j; d*_bj = theta*_(A,b),j - theta*_(B,b),j
q_lower = (1 + count_b(d*_bj <= 0))/(B+1); q_upper = (1 + count_b(d*_bj >= 0))/(B+1); p_two = min(1, 2 min(q_lower,q_upper))

references.citation: Dijkstra and Henseler (2015), Consistent Partial Least Squares Path Modeling
Sarstedt, Henseler, and Ringle (2011), Multigroup Analysis in Partial Least Squares Path Modeling: Alternative Methods and Empirical Results
Henseler, Ringle, and Sarstedt (2016), Testing Measurement Invariance of Composites Using Partial Least Squares
Planned independent Python PLSc group bootstrap, empirical-tail, interval, and invariance-link implementation

simulations.design: Two-group reflective common-factor models with equal parameters across sample size, imbalance, reliability, collinearity, and nonnormality cells that satisfy partial invariance.
simulations.seed_policy: Scenario and group-bootstrap indexed streams are independently domain separated and worker invariant.
simulations.acceptance_rule: For each supported cell, empirical rejection and interval coverage must lie within preregistered binomial bands, and every parameter must join the exact applicable invariance identity.

simulations.design: Known attenuation-corrected path and loading differences spanning effect size, imbalance, reliability, sample size, and partial/full invariance states.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen scenario-indexed data and independent domain-separated group-bootstrap streams.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Preregistered identifiable effects must meet the frozen bias, direction, and power envelopes; parameters lacking partial invariance must never yield an interpretable comparison claim.

simulations.design: One or both groups produce weak reliability, inadmissible corrected correlations, nonconvergence, singularity, or insufficient usable bootstrap fits.
simulations.seed_policy: Every group and replicate has a stable stream identity with no replacement after failure.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Failure accounting must independently reproduce and no tail probability or difference interval may be emitted unless both group distributions satisfy the frozen usability contract.

boundaries.case: An original group is inadmissible or one group bootstrap fails its usable threshold because of improper rho_A, corrected-correlation failure, nonconvergence, singularity, or nonfinite values.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Original failure blocks the run; bootstrap insufficiency suppresses MGA inference with explicit group-specific accounting.

boundaries.case: The request has other than two groups, configural mismatch, too few complete cases, unsupported PLSc shapes, missing consistent-permutation evidence, or parametric/Welch/one-tailed options.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Typed setup validation blocks execution or blocks interpretation with the exact reason.

boundaries.case: Group A/B are swapped or rows and constructs are consistently reordered.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Mapped differences reverse sign on group swap, two-sided tail probabilities remain equal, and reordered results agree within tolerance.

boundaries.case: Both group bootstraps execute under every supported worker count and schedule.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Resample plans, failures, paired differences, intervals, probabilities, invariance joins, and ordering are exactly equal.

boundaries.case: Group identity, bootstrap plan, counts, difference, probability, interval, invariance link, dataset fingerprint, or method identity is modified.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict project validation rejects the archive rather than displaying or exporting the changed comparison.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject a result whose consistent-MGA identity differs from the typed PLSc group recipe.
Reject plsc_mga_v1 paired with incompatible PLSc, consistent-bootstrap, or consistent-permutation versions.
Reject changed pooled/group complete-case manifests or a mismatched dataset fingerprint.
Reject any changed archive member whose checksum differs.
Reject duplicate keys, unknown fields, nonfinite values, bad counts, identities, differences, probabilities, intervals, or invariance joins.
Never reinterpret pls_mga_two_group_v1/v2, pls_mga_permutation_v1/v2, or ordinary bootstrap output as consistent MGA evidence.

persistence.legacy_policy: Only a typed plsc_mga_v1 result with exact plsc_bootstrap_v1 summaries and plsc_permutation_v1 invariance identity may satisfy this contract.

setup_controls: Group column and exact Group A/B values
native.gui_cli_parity_rule: For the same recipe, seed, method identities, groups, invariance result, and dataset fingerprint, GUI and CLI plans and analytical payloads must be exactly equal apart from operational timestamps.
accessibility_rules: Every group comparison graphic has an equivalent accessible table.
Invariance blockers, significance, direction, unavailable states, and warnings do not rely only on color or pointer interaction.
